root.name: Queen's Gambit Accepted: Winawer Defense
root.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. c4 dxc4 3. Nf3 Nf6 4. e3 Be6

overview: After 2...dxc4 3.Nf3 Nf6 4.e3, Black develops the light bishop to e6 before taking pressure on c4 and supports a quiet structure, with 5.Nc3 c6 the main line. White hopes to regain the pawn with Bxc4 or Ng5; Black holds the pawn on c4 with ...b5 or just returns it for a comfortable position. Play is calm and positional.

white_ideas.idea: Win back the pawn with Bxc4 or Ng5
Play Nc3, Be2 and O-O and push e4

black_ideas.idea: Support the extra pawn with ...c6 and ...b5

typical_structures.structure: White d4/e3 centre against Black pawns on e7, c7 and the captured c-pawn
Open c-file after c4 is exchanged

character.notes: Neither side takes real risks; positional play with small tactics.

gambit.notes: The c4 pawn returns by force or by sound play, so it is not a real gambit.

soundness.notes: A normal, safe line of the QGA.

structure.notes: The QGA exchange on c4 opens lines, as in the QGA anchor.

approach.notes: A normal QGA line seen at all levels.

level.notes: Plans are clear and theory is modest.
